caption:
Hybi's Weekly Recap for Feb 20–27 is here.

Night-time calf cramps? A wall calf stretch, 30 seconds two or three times on each side, can help. Taking the stairs is a free leg workout: hold the rail and start with one or two flights. In the car, set the seat so your knees stay slightly bent with the pedals down. And if your fingers go numb on long rides, try changing hand position every 10–15 minutes.
